options.why_wrong: After a fronted 'not until' clause, the main clause must be inverted; this uninverted order is incorrect.

options.text: so the committee announced its decision.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, which does not complete the time relation set up by 'not until'.

options.text: because the committee had to act quickly.
options.why_wrong: A cause does not complete the 'not until' pattern, which requires an inverted main clause expressing time.

options.text: did the committee announce its decision.

grammar_focus: Negative inversion after a fronted 'not until' clause
explanation: When a sentence begins with 'not until', the main clause that follows must be inverted, with the auxiliary verb before the subject. This pattern is common in formal and written English.
